Classic: Some of the villagers are werewolves. At night they hunt, by day they act as if nothing has happened. The phone is the game master – it tells everyone what to do.
Send mobilen rundt. Hold fingeren på kor: Pass the phone round. Hold your finger on the card to see whether you're a werewolf, the seer, the doctor or a villager.
Alle lukker øynene og nynner. Den som få: Everyone closes their eyes and hums. Whoever gets the phone does their night job in silence and passes it on. Everyone does something, so nobody can guess roles from the timing.
Mobilen forteller hvem ulvene tok. Snakk: The phone tells you who the wolves took. Talk it over, point at the same time and vote out the one you suspect. Their role is revealed.
Landsbyen vinner når alle varulvene er u: The village wins when all the werewolves are out. The werewolves win when there are as many of them as everyone else.
Varulvene vet hvem de andre varulvene er: The werewolves know who the other werewolves are, and see what the others have chosen at night.
Den synske ser om én person er varulv hv: The seer finds out whether one person is a werewolf each night. The doctor protects one person – but not the same one two nights running.
Jeger (valgfri): Blir jegeren tatt eller: Hunter (optional): If the hunter is taken or voted out, they take one person with them.
Fredelig første natt (valgfri): Alle tar: Peaceful first night (optional): Everyone takes their night turn and the seer looks – but nobody is taken. That way everyone gets to play before anyone is out.
Den første som ryker ut, blir spilleder:: The first one out becomes the game master: holds the phone, reads aloud and counts the fingers. If you're out later, you keep quiet for the rest of the game – but you're welcome to watch and laugh.
Én natt: Alle får en rolle, mobilen går: One night: Everyone gets a role, the phone goes once round the table, and some roles get swapped in the dark. Then you have four minutes to point out a werewolf. Nobody is out.

Who's a werewolf? Tell, ask and bluff. Remember that roles may have swapped in the night – maybe yours too.
Landsbyen vinner hvis en varulv er blant: The village wins if a werewolf is among those with the most fingers. Otherwise the werewolves win. The winners get one point each.
